confirmation.promotion_rule: Rank completed screening runs by best pooled validation PQ; promote the top two non-baseline configurations to fresh 20-epoch training. No combinations or additional tuning.
confirmation.baseline_anchor: runs/E0_baseline_seed42 if all 20 epochs complete; otherwise fresh fixed-budget baseline in runs/full/baseline_seed42
confirmation.selection_rule: Highest best-checkpoint PQ_dataset at full budget. Exact ties prefer baseline, then fewer parameters, then variant name.
confirmation.promotion_tie_break: Fewer parameters, then variant name for exact screening-PQ ties.

final.representative_rule: Highest validation PQ among the three fresh-seed best checkpoints; exact ties prefer lower seed.

notes: Same frozen split, 960 samples and 240 planned optimizer update attempts per epoch; input resolution changes compute and field of view, not just pixel scale.
Separate training-only normalization per preprocessing variant, bounded to 200 training observations.
Consensus changes target construction and observation weighting.
Tversky prioritizes missed foreground; it does not explicitly constrain topology.
Best validation PQ chooses checkpoints and configurations. Validation scores are not an unbiased hidden-test estimate.
Three fresh seeds estimate training-run variability; per-image standard deviations are separate.
Single-seed full-budget comparisons cannot establish statistical significance of gains over the baseline.
Threshold0.5, original-resolution scoring, and simple connected components stay fixed; advanced separation/compression remain Person C work.
No Kaggle or ClickUP uploads; no external test labels or prohibited metadata.
Six-epoch screening may favor quick-learning configurations; only the two promoted alternatives and baseline are compared at full budget. No global optimum is claimed.
The no_augmentation variant disables added geometric and photometric transforms; random foreground-biased crop sampling remains enabled.

clarifications.reason: Completed baseline recorded three legitimate AMP gradient-overflow skipped steps. Equal budgets mean equal samples/update attempts; actual optimizer and skipped counts are reported. No training settings or selection rules changed.
